arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, about 32-34 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 160-166 W pod, boat CP 101 W) after the hard start; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until 1500 m to go, then spend it down to empty by the line; finish sprint at about 400-500 m to go. Watch for incidents: speed drop at same pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod reading drifting vs boat-model power, wind or current changes between legs, radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell). Compare legs in same direction with legs().
Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current push; strongly negative = extra drag (weed) or pod reading high

arguments.message: speed through water low for the pod power: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift
pod reserve low with far to go

arguments.reason: plan the final spend of reserve

text: Cued ease to settle after a start 30 percent above critical power; set plan, drag and reserve watches, wake-ups at 1500 m and 550 m to go.

arguments.text: 4.0 min: pod 169 W vs sustainable shaft 165 W, pod reserve 0.70 (empties 3775 m) = on target. Boat-model reserve 53 % drains faster (boat 114 W vs CP 101); boat/shaft ratio 0.68 vs test 0.64 and push_local 0.31 > push_along 0.19 on leg 1, so boat power likely inflated by current fit. Trust the pod for pacing until legs compare.

text: no cue: pod power 169 W is right at the sustainable 165 W with 70 percent reserve; noted boat-model reserve is likely inflated by the current fit.

arguments.text: Looking strong. Hold exactly this effort, save it for later.

7.1 min: paddler says 4/10, plenty. Pod 171 W vs sustainable 165, pod reserve 0.59 (empties 2550 m at this power). Boat-model reserve 17 % and empties in 284 m, but no fade (-0.4 %): if boat reserve hits 0 with no fade, boat CP / W prime (101 W / 6.9 kJ) is too low; boat W prime is inconsistent with shaft (6.9 vs 20.1*0.64=12.9 kJ). Legs: out 3.26 m/s, back 2.94 at same 170 W pod -> current about +0.16 out. Cued hold.

text: Cued hold: pod power slightly above sustainable but paddler reports 4/10 with no fade, so keep this effort and watch whether the boat-model reserve estimate is too pessimistic.

arguments.reason: Boat-model reserve read empty at 10 min with no forced slowdown (GPS speed steady at same pod power). Boat/shaft power ratio is 0.64 as in the test, so boat CP 101 W matches shaft CP 157 W, but boat W prime 6.9 kJ is inconsistent with shaft 20.1 kJ x 0.64 = 12.9 kJ.

arguments.text: Ease a fraction. Smooth and long, still a long way.

arguments.message: pod power well below CP: paddler forced down, overeased, or an incident

arguments.text: 10.0 min: GPS speed steady 2.92-2.93 on leg 2 at 168-171 W pod; the apparent fade (-2 %) is the push fit revising, not the paddler. Boat W prime corrected 6.9 -> 12.9 kJ (boat reserve now 45 %, pod 51 %). Pod 170 W vs sustainable 164, pod reserve empties in 2310 m at this power -> cued ease a fraction. Target about 162-165 W pod. Added watch forced_down (pod < 145 W).

text: Cued ease a fraction: pod 170 W is 6 W above the sustainable 164 W and would empty the reserve 1850 m from the finish; corrected the boat reserve size, which read empty with no slowdown.
no cue: pod power 164-168 W is at the sustainable 165 W after the ease; leg 3 speed matches leg 1; boat-model reserve swings with the current fit on out legs, pacing on the pod.

arguments.reason: Pod is drifting high since race min 12.8 (pod 163 -> 199 W while GPS speed, rate and paddler effort 4/10 unchanged), so pacing moves to the boat model. Race boat/shaft ratio before the drift was 0.66-0.68 (test 0.64), so the pod CP 157 W corresponds to about 105 W at the boat.

arguments.message: boat-model reserve low with far to go (pod is unreliable)
speed through water well below the usual 3.0-3.1: weed, drag, current change or paddler forced down

arguments.text: 15.2 min: POD DRIFT. Pod rose 163 -> 199 W from race min 12.8 to 15.1 as a ramp while GPS speed (3.23-3.24 out), rate 70 and speed through water were unchanged; paddler again 4/10 plenty. So the pod reads about 20 % high: ignore shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, sustainable_shaft_power_w, push_local_mps. True effort is still about 165 W pod = sustainable. Pace on GPS by leg direction (out about 3.24, back about 2.92 m/s) and boat model (set boat CP 105 W, W prime 12.9 kJ). Watches now boat_reserve_low and slow_water.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, about 32-33 min. POD DRIFTING HIGH since min 12.8 (see notes): do not pace on shaft_power_w or pod reserve. Pace on GPS speed by leg direction (out about 3.24 m/s, back about 2.92 m/s at true sustainable effort), stroke rate about 70, and the boat model (CP 105 W, W prime 12.9 kJ; reserve w_bal_frac). Paddler says 4/10 at 15 min. Keep even effort until 1500 m to go, then build; finish sprint at about 450 m to go so the reserve empties at the line. If GPS speed drops at the same rate and feel: suspect weed (clear_rudder) or current change; compare legs().

text: no cue: the low-reserve alert came from pod drift (pod +20 percent while GPS speed, rate and the paddler feel are unchanged); moved pacing to GPS and the boat model, recalibrated boat CP, replaced the pod-based watches.

arguments.text: Weed on the rudder. One back-stroke to clear it now.

arguments.reason: check speed recovered after clear_rudder (leg 4 back was 2.79-2.80 m/s vs 2.92 on leg 2)

arguments.text: 18.3 min: leg 4 back GPS speed fell to 2.79-2.80 m/s (leg 2 back 2.92) from about race_s 1040, rate 70 unchanged; paddler says boat feels heavy, like something dragging, effort 4/10. Cued clear_rudder. If speed back near 2.92 after, weed confirmed and cleared; if not, suspect current change and compare next out leg with 3.22-3.26.

text: Cued clear_rudder: GPS speed on this back leg fell 4 percent below the last back leg at the same rate and the paddler reports the boat dragging; checking recovery in 70 s.
no cue: slow_water alert is the back-stroke dip still inside the 30 s speed average; recovery check already scheduled at race 1166 s.

arguments.text: Rudder is clear, boat is free. Back to your rhythm.

19.4 min: WEED CONFIRMED AND CLEARED. After clear_rudder at 18.3 min (back-stroke seen, 36 % dip) GPS speed back to about 2.93 on leg 4 back (= leg 2 back 2.92), speed through water 3.10. Cued hold. Boat-model reserve 31 % with 2430 m to go (CP 105, W prime 12.9). If speed drops again at the same feel, weed may be back: clear again.

text: Cued hold: speed recovered to the leg-2 level after the back-stroke, so the weed is cleared; told the paddler the boat is free and to resume the same rhythm.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 x 1000 m out (north, legs 1,3,5) and back (south, legs 2,4,6; finish heading south). POD DRIFTED HIGH from min 12.8: ignore shaft_power_w and pod reserve. WIND from the south 8-12 kn filling in from min 20 (radio): headwind on south legs incl. the final leg, tailwind on leg 5; the boat model and push fit will misread the wind as paddler effort, so pace on feel, rate about 70 and paddler reports (3-4/10, plenty, so far). Plan: hold steady effort on tailwind leg 5 (do not ease, paddler is fresh); put the reserve into the headwind final leg: push from the last turn at 1000 m to go, finish sprint from about 450 m to go. Weed was cleared at 18.3 min; a sudden speed drop with a dragging feel = clear_rudder again.

arguments.reason: start of tailwind leg 5: check paddler, hold
after last turn: push into the headwind final leg

arguments.message: speed through water very low even allowing for wind: weed again or paddler forced down

arguments.text: 20.3 min: radio says wind from the south 8-12 kn filling in. GPS speed on leg 4 back sliding gradually 2.93 -> 2.84 since race_s 1180 (gradual = wind, not weed); paddler 3/10, all good, plenty, no dragging. Boat-model reserve 29 % but wind and pod drift make every reserve number unreliable; paddler keeps reporting low effort, so reserve may be larger than models say. Plan: hold leg 5 (tailwind), spend on leg 6 headwind.

text: no cue: south wind filling in explains the gradual speed loss on this south leg (paddler 3/10, no drag); replanned to hold on the tailwind leg and spend the reserve into the headwind final leg, with wake-ups at 1960, 975 and 450 m to go.

arguments.text: Tailwind leg. Hold this rhythm, save your power for the headwind home.

22.3 min, 1960 m to go, start of leg 5 (north, tailwind): paddler 3/10 plenty again (4 reports all 3-4/10). End of leg 4 headwind GPS 2.71. Cued hold. At 975 m to go: push into the headwind; consider a second push about 60-70 s later if the paddler still reports plenty; finish at about 450 m.

text: Cued hold on the tailwind leg: effort is better spent on the headwind final leg, and the paddler reports 3/10 with plenty left.
no cue: boat-model reserve alert is the tailwind being read as paddler power (GPS 3.42 m/s on this north leg, rate and pod unchanged); holding until the headwind final leg as planned.

arguments.text: Last leg, into the wind. Push now, build all the way home.

arguments.reason: check response to the push; second push if paddler still has plenty

text: Cued push at the start of the headwind final leg, where extra effort buys the most time; the paddler has reported plenty all race and the low boat-model reserve is the tailwind misread.
